## About
Andy's Auto is a family-owned collision and mechanical repair shop on Bower Hill Road, in the heart of Bridgeville. Our customers come from right here in town and from around the Pittsburgh area.
Owner Andy Dugas started the shop to give people solid work at an affordable price, because price doesn't always reflect quality. His standard is simple: it has to be right, it has to be safe, and it has to look like it was never damaged to begin with.
We guarantee our work. If you're doing your homework on shops before your next repair, stop by and say hello.

## Services
- Collision repair: From a small fender-bender to a major accident, we restore your car physically and structurally and make sure it meets the manufacturer's specifications.
- Mechanical repair: Regular maintenance through complex repairs, including diagnostic testing, oil changes, tires and balancing, wheel alignments, air conditioning, exhaust and tune-ups.
- State inspections and emissions: Pennsylvania state inspections and emissions testing at the shop.
- Brakes and rotors: Brake and rotor work, along with shocks, struts, CV joints and other parts that keep your car safe on the road.
- New driver workshops: Interactive workshops for new drivers. One reviewer called it a great workshop for those about to get their licenses, or a refresher for those who already have them.

## FAQ
Q: Will you deal with my insurance company after an accident?
A: Yes. We work directly with your insurance company on claims and help you get a rental car while yours is in the shop.

Q: Do you do state inspections?
A: Yes, we handle state inspections and emissions.
